registration.gdprConsent: I agree that my personal information will be collected and processed by Impact Centre Chrétien in accordance with the terms of the privacy policy.
registration.gdprFullText:
The information requested here will be used for the internal management needs of Impact Centre Chrétien. You may exercise your right of access under the conditions provided by Law 78/17 of January 6, 1978 on information technology, files, and freedoms. If you wish to notify us of any changes, modifications, or deletion, please send an email to contact@impactcentrechretien.com.

ICC does not engage in the sale of members' or guests' data. Please note that ICC has a Data Protection Officer, and at any time, you can contact them at the following email address: dpo.icc@impactcentrechretien.com.
registration.preferredSchedule: Choose the desired class (based on the schedule that suits you best)
registration.emailDescription: This email address must be unique for each registered student
registration.whatsappDescription: Please provide your WhatsApp number in the international format
registration.departmentDescription: Enter the department number in 2 or 3 digits: 75 if you are in Paris, 33 for Gironde, 971 for Guadeloupe, ...
registration.scheduleDescription: The times displayed are in Paris time (UTC +2 time zone). Please calculate your class times according to your time zone. For example, if a time slot is listed as Tuesday at 1:00 AM, it refers to the night from Monday to Tuesday.

alerts.info1: You can only take one course at a time. Registration in two courses simultaneously is prohibited.
alerts.info2: If you have been converted for less than a year or have not been baptized by immersion, we encourage you to register for course 001 (Welcome to the Kingdom).
alerts.info3: The courses will only be conducted online via the Zoom platform.
alerts.info4: ATTENTION: The displayed times are in Paris time (UTC +2 time zone). Please calculate your class times according to your time zone. If a class is scheduled on Thursday at 01:15, it means the night from Wednesday to Thursday in Paris time. For someone in Montreal, this class starts Wednesday at 19:15. For someone in Martinique, this class starts Wednesday at 20:15.
alerts.info5: If you are under 18 years old at the time of participating in the training, your registration must be completed by one of your parents or a legal representative. In the form, they will provide your contact information. Then, they must complete, sign, and return the following form, PARENTAL AUTHORIZATION FOR MINORS, to the email address pcnc.corp@egliseicc.com to validate the registration.
